items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Stanley, if I may say so -- in '55 the band featured -- by then it featured Thad Jones and Joe Wilder.

ctx.x: Well, I think that's a very good and clever proper way of Basie's get caught, anyway. I mean, alot of people try to give advice or influence or something, and Basie always, or nearly always said just as you said. When the men came up and talked about the bootleg record, you know -- he gives a big smile -- says "nice" and so on and so on, but it doesn't offer after anything.

Do you remember that arrangement the band was playing about seven or eight years ago -- 'St. Louis Blues' It was a long thing. I think it was a head or maybe Thad had something to do with it. But, you know --
